question: Park the levels idea, or try more versions?
context: The levels idea (trade the first touch of strong price levels) lost about 0.12 R per filled trade after fees on the development data (255 trades, 517 ideas never filled). The range is wide, so the desk says NOT ENOUGH DATA rather than FAILED, and more data does not exist in this window. Every extra version tried makes a lucky-looking result more likely.
default: Parked: no more versions and no run on the held-back data.
